The *Ucchuvimānavatthu* (Vv 48) is a canonical verse text of the *Vimānavatthu* in the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. In this poem, translated as "Sugarcane Mansion", a celestial being (*deva*) recounts the karmic fruits obtained by having given a small piece of sugarcane to the Arahant Moggallāna [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral identifies a full parallel within the same collection, the *Ucchudāyikāvimānavatthu* (Vv 30) [SuttaCentral]. Text-reuse data from DharmaNexus corroborates this assessment, identifying four matching passages covering segments 0.1–12.1 between Vv 48 and Vv 30 with 0.98 similarity [DharmaNexus]. Five modern translations across five languages are indexed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
